before: Wall representative plane = measured pixel line centrelines/outer faces from pixel_profile scans, not nominal 240mm offsets.

Window/door heights: North window sill1.0/head3.4m, South windows sill1.0/head2.8m (directly measured from elevations). East/West window heights assumed equal to North pattern (sill1.0/head3.4m) since exact per-opening E/W sill/head was not independently re-derived.
All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level); a 200mm sub-dimension near doors in elevations is treated as threshold/frame annotation, not a raised sill.
Building height 4.5m used uniformly as the single floor's wall height per all four elevations.

The corridor (north-south spine) and the south-east furniture area merge into ONE physical room: pixel evidence shows no full-height wall separating them (only a short non-connecting wall fragment near x440-560,y698 which cannot close a valid separate region and was omitted).
Room roles (reception, office, boardroom, meeting, pantry, corridor/open office) are inferred from furniture symbols, not labelled in the source.
after: Wall representative plane = measured pixel line centrelines/outer faces from pixel_profile scans, not nominal 240mm offsets.

Window/door heights: North and East windows sill1.0/head3.4m (directly measured from North_view.png and East_view.png in this review). South and West windows sill1.0/head2.8m (directly measured from South_view.png and West_view.png in this review; West value corrects an inherited unverified assumption that had copied the North pattern).

All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level); sub-dimensions near doors in elevations are treated as threshold/frame annotation, not a raised sill or reduced height -- this specific figure was not fully reconciled against the door elevation chain in this review and remains an assumption.
Building height 4.5m used uniformly as the single floor's wall height, confirmed identical (4500mm) on all four elevations in this review.

The corridor (north-south spine) and the south-east furniture area merge into ONE physical room: re-verified in this review by a zoomed crop at [440,580,615,890] -- the partial wall/door near x458-611,y698 does not reach the west corridor edge as a full-height partition (open gap on its west side down to the south wall), so it cannot enclose a separate room; it is modeled as furniture-defining millwork within the open room, not a partition.

The full-width north strip (Lobby, x248-611,y151-296) was re-checked in this review at [380,145,430,300]: no vertical wall exists between x=400 and the north wall above y=296, confirming Lobby is genuinely one open room across the full width (not split at x=400), consistent with the single Lobby space_seed already covering it.
Room roles (reception, office, boardroom, meeting, pantry, corridor/open office) are inferred from furniture symbols, not labelled in the source.
